'''Steve White DS Anti-Op''' is a [[Dark]] Ralltiir Operations list Steve White posted against Light Operatives.<ref name="list-66574">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/66574.html? swccg-discussion message #66574], Steve White (1 December 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108000903/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/66574.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Steve White
* '''Published:''' 1 December 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Decree|CC-D-imperialdecree.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' DS Anti-Op
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE AntiOp White DS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

White posted a revised list after adding Twi'lek Advisor and Executor.

== Strategy ==

Flip Ralltiir Operations, lock drains with Imperial Decree and Resistance, then Commence Primary Ignition from the Death Star.
